name: usage-meter
description: Shows context used and session cost under the prompt, and warns when either passes a threshold you set.

contextWarnTokens.title: Context warning (tokens)
contextWarnTokens.description: Warn once when the context window passes this many tokens.

costWarnUsd.title: First cost warning (USD)
costWarnUsd.description: Warn when this session's cost first passes this many dollars.

costStepUsd.title: Repeat cost warning every (USD)
costStepUsd.description: After the first warning, warn again each time cost grows by this much.
